note: Ground punch from half guard. His chest is flat here too — its forward points straight down at the mat and its up points along the mat ahead of him — so the mount's clip, which cocks the hand 'up' in the chest's frame, sent the hand out over the man's head and swung the upper arm behind the shoulder on 5 frames of 15. With a leg trapped there is no room to posture and wind up anyway: the hand lifts off him, turns over and drives back down. The elbow stays poled down and out, where half guard already holds it.

keys.note: cocked: a short lift clear of him, not a wind-up
